title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bryan College of Health Sciences
description: A collection of late-night dining and study-break destinations near the Bryan East Campus, catering to the schedules of nursing and health sciences students.

cards.title: The Hospital Cafeteria
cards.subtitle: On-campus dining at Bryan East
cards.notes: Visit the cafeteria for a 30% student discount on prepared items. It serves as a primary late-night resource for students during clinical rotations or long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus dining facility offering discounts to Bryan College students.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryan College students receive a 30% discount on most prepared items in the cafeterias at Bryan Medical Center East and West Campus.
cards.source_title: Nutrition & Dining Services Gift Cards are available for Students! - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open daily for various meal services; check internal schedules for specific late-night grab-and-go availability.

cards.title: The Nebraska Burrito Run
cards.subtitle: 2748 S 48th St
cards.notes: Drive through for a Nebraska Burrito after a late shift. This local favorite is known for large portions and authentic recipes just south of the college.
cards.short_summary: A staple local Mexican restaurant offering late-night drive-thru service near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Leon's Mexican Food at 2748 S 48th St offers online ordering and late-night service for its authentic Mexican menu.
cards.source_title: D'Leon's Mexican Restaurant - D'Leon's "Taco Rico" Mexican Food
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically open late; check specific daily hours for the South 48th Street location.

cards.title: Cane's on 48th
cards.subtitle: 403 N 48th St
cards.notes: Head north on 48th Street for a Box Combo. The drive-thru stays open until 1:00 AM, making it a reliable stop for late-night protein.
cards.short_summary: A popular chicken finger chain with late-night hours located a short drive north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Raising Cane's at 403 North 48th Street in Lincoln closes at 1:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Lincoln, NE, - 403 North 48th Street

cards.title: 24-Hour Pancake Study Break
cards.subtitle: 4501 N 27th St
cards.notes: Drive to the 27th Street location for 24/7 breakfast. It is a go-to for students needing a full meal and a booth at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast diner providing a consistent late-night environment for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP at 4501 N 27th St in Lincoln is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Lincoln, NE on 4501 N 27th St

cards.title: The Soft Taco Stop
cards.subtitle: 1901 N 48th St
cards.notes: Order a Crisp Meat Burrito or soft tacos at this Nebraska-based chain. The drive-thru is a frequent stop for students traveling between campus and North Lincoln.
cards.short_summary: A local fast-food hybrid serving Mexican and American favorites with late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Amigos/Kings Classic has multiple locations in Lincoln, including 48th Street, known for late-night service and a diverse menu.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically open until midnight or later; check specific location for current hours.

cards.title: The Original Runza Run
cards.subtitle: 4901 O St
cards.notes: Grab a classic Runza sandwich and Frings at the 48th & O location. This Nebraska institution is a mandatory stop for any student in Lincoln.
cards.short_summary: The iconic Nebraska fast-food chain serving its signature stuffed bread sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Runza has a location at 4901 O Street, Suite 2, near the intersection of 48th and O, close to Bryan East.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typical closing hours are 10:30 PM.

cards.title: ButterBurgers & Custard
cards.subtitle: 4121 Pioneer Woods Dr
cards.notes: Drive south for a late-night Concrete Mixer or ButterBurger. The drive-thru remains open until 10:00 PM for a quick sweet or savory fix.
cards.short_summary: A popular midwestern chain known for frozen custard and burgers, located southeast of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Culver's at 4121 Pioneer Woods Drive in Lincoln is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Lincoln, NE - Pioneer Woods Dr
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and lobby open until 10:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Late-Night Half-Price Apps
cards.subtitle: 3730 Village Dr
cards.notes: Meet friends for late-night appetizers at the Old Cheney location. It's a common spot for nursing students to unwind after evening clinicals.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining restaurant offering late-night hours and appetizer specials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Applebee's at 3730 Village Drive (Old Cheney) is open until 10:00 PM or later depending on the day.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar Restaurant in Lincoln, NE, 68516
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM or midnight depending on the day; check current late-night app specials.

cards.title: The Study Fuel Stop
cards.subtitle: 333 N 48th St
cards.notes: Pick up a caffeine boost at the Starbucks inside Target. It's a convenient stop for supplies and coffee just north of the Bryan East campus.
cards.short_summary: A convenient coffee location for students to grab beverages while shopping for essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starbucks Cafe inside the Target at 333 N 48th St is open until 8:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily; located inside Target.

cards.title: The 16-Inch Sub Run
cards.subtitle: 1801 N 84th St
cards.notes: Grab a giant sub for a long night of studying. Known for soft bread and sliced-to-order meats, it's a reliable deli option east of campus.
cards.short_summary: A deli offering fresh sub sandwiches with evening hours for student meal runs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Goodcents at 1801 N 84th St in Lincoln is open until 9:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Deli Fresh Subs in Lincoln, NE 68505 - Goodcents
